title: Pumpkin soup
instructions: Cut the pumpkin and potatoes into reasonably sized chunks.
Put them to boil with as little water as possible. Season with salt, pepper, pinch of nutmeg, and the broth cube.
Once tender, remove it from the heat and wait until it cools down slightly.
Add heavy cream and then process it until smooth with a hand mixer.
Heat up if needed, season to taste, and serve with a light splash of heavy cream for the color + toasted seeds on top.
